comments.body:
@pcbeingused333, please stack related PRs in the proper order.
I approved #2200 without knowledge of this PR.
It appears this PR should go first. 
And create a common Issue for both PRs.
Do you really need 2 PRs?
Thanks

One pull request is enough. The install-guide edit is on this branch, so this can merge on `main` by itself. #2200 does not need another base.

The example now uses `mistral-medium-2604` and `mistral-small-2603`. The reasoning line used `magistral-medium-2509`, which this pull request removes from the catalog; it now uses `mistral-medium-2604`, the successor already named for Magistral Medium 1.2. The list also marks `magistral-small-2509` and `devstral-2512` retired, with the successors this pull request already names (`mistral-small-2603` and `mistral-medium-2604`).

#2200 stays on `main` as already approved. If this combined change is right, that pull request is superseded and can be closed. #2246 tracks the retired ids in the catalog and the guide.

This comment was prepared with the help of an AI coding assistant.
